Name: Wobbuffet Statue
Author: 2sober
Description:
This replaces the mill with a huge Wobbuffet (Woingenau, ソーナンス) statue, in case that is something you want to put on your farm.
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.

Note: The screenshots include a lot of other mods - this mod only contains the wobbuffet statue!
